Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: standalone transparent constructible sawmill sprite for the project's fixed isometric game camera.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact visual authority: the project's own forest_sawmill concept. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY its complete small lower-right sawmill/workshop, preserving its terracotta tile roof and stone chimney, timber frame, roof lean-to, working circular saw table and short attached log/plank stacks. This must be the SAME charming detailed painted building, not a redesigned generic building. Keep its exact elevated orthographic view, lighting, chunky detailed volume, warm timber, tiles, stone and original proportions.
Remove ALL surrounding forest, trees, nursery fence, saplings, large rocks and landscape. Isolate the coherent sawmill building and only a tiny attached foundation/contact shadow on genuine RGBA transparency. No broad earth/grass floor or square ground plate. Its shadow can be soft and close to its footprint. Enlarge and center the extracted building on a square canvas for high detail, keeping the whole roof/chimney/side structures and ground contacts fully visible with 8 percent transparent margins. Show the same camera-facing sides as in the reference, no rotation or mirroring. The building will be overlaid on the exact clearing where it stood; preserve its reference appearance closely. No people, text, interface, watermark, extra machines or modern additions. One complete building asset, not a sheet or collage.
